title: Conditional κ = 7.11032242134072e-4: fixed prime, eight finite levels and η = 10⁻²⁴ on #263's descent-retimed multicut word
body:
Conditional κ = `711032242134072007667807/10^27` = **7.11032242134072e-4**, exactly `3933374007667807/10^27` (+3.93 × 10⁻¹²) over [#263](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/263) (7.11032238200698e-4). Stacked on #263's branch at `8712930` (PR259's 518-entrance multi-cut condensation plus the 25-gate concave-descent retiming); the physical word, frames, banks, routes and invoice are unchanged.

**Full replay: PASS.** `verify.py --output /tmp/multicut-descent-fixed-prime` reran #263's complete native pipeline (`PASS: kappa = 0.000711032238200698`, `PASS_ALL_SEVEN_NATIVE_CHECKERS_AND_PINNED_RECEIPTS`) and then the fixed-prime arithmetic: `{"status": "PASS_PR263_MULTICUT_DESCENT_FIXED_PRIME_REFINEMENT", "kappa": "711032242134072007667807/1000000000000000000000000000", "exact_gain": "3933374007667807/1000000000000000000000000000", "strict_outer_constraints": 47, "native_checkers": 7, "parent_commit": "87129308f762f86a9d8e9a60f5d6c8ef23ce1f6e", "inputs_unchanged": true}`.

## Change

This is sennemmi's [#261](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/261) refinement (after Gabriele Nespoli's #235 and my #252) retargeted from #259 to #263. Only three fixed arithmetic parameters change relative to #263's native price: the proved rare-class density `2m³/q` with `q = 2^127 − 1` replaces the 10⁻¹⁶ envelope (the full `32m²` fallback is still paid); eight finite ordinary levels instead of three; outer backoff `η = 10⁻²⁴` (`β = 10⁻⁹` unchanged). All 47 strict outer inequalities and 7 margins are rechecked; the adjacent 10⁻²⁷ grid point fails. The fresh counted coefficient is `62639556732985401 < 2^80 < q` (it moved from #261's `62639910650427201` because the retiming removes 40 calls per normalized profile).

## Verification

`research/multicut-kernel-condensation-descent-fixed-prime/verify.py` pins #263's package (manifest, RESULT, price and invoice receipts, physical word hash, commit ancestry), reruns `research/multicut-kernel-condensation/verify.py` end to end (baseline regenerated from source, cohort transform, descent retiming, all seven native checkers, pinned receipts), requires #263's κ and profile (stock 173,435, 3,956,800 calls, rank mass 20,777,000, deficit 35,200), then recomputes the fixed-prime moments with both rational engines, the eight cutoff levels and the outer assembly, and compares every value to `expected.json`. `Prime.lean` kernel-checks the prime and density facts (workflow job); that Lean check does not prove the multiplication theorem.

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/multicut-kernel-condensation-descent-fixed-prime/requirements.txt
python3 -B research/multicut-kernel-condensation-descent-fixed-prime/verify.py --output /tmp/multicut-descent-fixed-prime
```

Python 3.11+, SymPy 1.14.0, C++17 GNU-compatible compiler and Boost headers; new output directory outside the checkout; no network.

## Scope and credits

Exactly #263/#259's hypotheses and conditional interfaces; the large fixed prime makes initialization and table constants enormous but finite and paid, as argued in #235's PROOF.md. No unconditional multiplication bound, benchmark or Lean certification of the theorem is claimed.

sennemmi (#261, #230), Gabriele Nespoli (#235), Dugongue (#259, #254), eumemic (#249, #244, #210) and the retained lineage. Retargeting prepared by Rohan Arun with Anthropic Claude assistance.
